title: Holdout and species inventory
headline: Clade decision open: Aves is frozen (provisional) and blind for all 16 completed tests but underpowered; Mammalia would make 1 of 2 exams decisive but is post hoc for 3 already-built tests (power table on /t/holdout/). 9 nanopub records drafted (unsigned, unpublished): 3 inconclusive exams, the pre-registered organism hypothesis, the clade analysis, the leak check, the triage, 2 burned items; np check and Delphi lint clean. Awaiting the key owner for signing and the test registry. Leak check clean. Merge conflicts 0.
